sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details suspicious online debit card activity indicative of an organized device-sharing ring and potential card testing. On December 9, 2016, at approximately 02:39 UTC, an online purchase totaling $35.66 was conducted using a customer's debit card. The transaction originated from a Windows-based desktop device utilizing a commercial web browser and a public email domain. Further investigation revealed that this single desktop device has been shared across at least seven distinct customer accounts and seven separate payment cards, generating 286 transactions across the financial institution. In addition, the card exhibited accelerated transaction velocity, recording 25 transactions within a 24-hour period and two transactions within a single hour surrounding the flagged event. Historical activity associated with the account also reflects fragmented usage spanning 14 different billing regions and 20 distinct email domains. The combination of a low-dollar transaction, rapid transaction velocity, and extensive multi-account device consolidation strongly indicates coordinated card-testing fraud. The institution has applied enhanced monitoring to the card account and is filing this narrative to assist law enforcement in identifying broader organized fraud network activities.
